captions.detailed: A low-profile, matte black air fryer featuring a wide rectangular body and a matching sliding drawer basket. The front face includes a narrow control strip with a rotating browning dial and two small rectangular push buttons. The drawer has a wide integrated handle with a spring-loaded release plunger to unlock the inner basket.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact, wide-scale air fryer. Include a main body shell, a sliding front basket drawer with a handle and release plunger, a rotating control dial, and two push buttons on the front control panel.
captions.factory: Create the main body by shelling a filleted box primitive to form the cooking cavity. Model the drawer using a hollowed-out box for the basket, adding a horizontal handle bar and a small plunger block. Construct the control panel using a rotating cylinder for the dial and small extruded boxes for the push buttons, assembling everything using prismatic and revolute joints.
